content.content:
Applied by a reviewer reading the recorded dependent against each of its recorded prerequisites in turn, from the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

(1) Licence. No element of the dependent may contradict the prerequisite it is read against. Fail, naming the element and the prerequisite it contradicts, if any element of the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome that prerequisite fixes, or narrows the prerequisite by excepting a case the prerequisite covers.

(2) Reading a structured prerequisite. A prerequisite that records a value for an element, an aspect and a state fixes that value for that element, aspect and state. An element of the dependent that fixes a different value for the same element, aspect and state, or that requires the value the prerequisite records to carry a subject or meaning other than the one that prerequisite records it for, contradicts the prerequisite under (1). Fail, naming the element and the prerequisite.

(3) Independence. The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular clause of any prerequisite; which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent and invents no rule its prerequisites do not state.

(4) No recorded subject. A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in a prerequisite the check is read against, leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: The dependent mplxzxnm is a commitment in words (inline prose, natural layer) whose use of each prerequisite is a licensed use, not a behaviour to observe. mwwxxzyk is a commitment in words (natural layer), so that edge sits in the matrix's natural-to-natural gate cell, evals/natural-to-natural.md, whose licence check is copied as clause (1): no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite, with the contradicting element named only in the check's output. rusopkql is inline prose (natural layer), a second instance of that same cell and the same question, so the same clause covers it. mnwxnyks is a visual-spec document in a fixed field grammar (structured layer) read by a natural child; the matrix has no structured-to-natural cell, so that edge takes the documented default, the gate form plus a flag for a matrix entry, and clause (2) states how the licence check reads a prerequisite that fixes a recorded value. One evaluation covers all three edges because it is one question asked of one dependent text — does the dependent contradict a prerequisite it was drawn against — and a second evaluation would gate the same layer pairs twice with the same criterion. The three uses are distinct in what they lean on: mwwxxzyk for the listed entry remaining a link, so the dependent is licensed only as far as it leaves the link-ness alone; rusopkql for an entry that is listed but carries no mark of its own, so the dependent may not turn the recorded condition into a mark the entry does not carry; mnwxnyks for the colour role and value it records, so the dependent may spend that recorded value but not substitute another or load the same value with a different subject. Because every endpoint is words or a recorded value and none is an artifact, any behaviour probe — what the viewer draws, what a click does — would exceed both the child's layer and these prerequisites, and is gated where the viewer becomes a code-layer artifact. The criterion defines no scope for the dependent, restates none of it, and survives rewriting it without changing what it decides.
